title: Mob Speedometer
description: A modified version of SilicatYT's Speed Display datapack that works on other mobs
body:
A modified version of [SilicatYT's Speed Display datapack](https://youtu.be/8jTtenb3goQ), which works on later versions and allows you to find the speeds of other mobs (it also includes vertical speed). To select a mob, simply give it the ```speed``` tag, and it will be displayed in the center of the screen.
